---
title: "Python Naming Conventions"
---

+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| Convention                           | Typical Python use           | Examples                   |
+======================================+==============================+============================+
| PascalCase / CapWords                | Classes, exceptions, type    | pandas `DataFrame`; Django |
|                                      | names                        | models                     |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| camelCase                            | Rare; mirrors external       | JS / JSON / cloud API      |
|                                      | APIs[^camel]                 | fields                     |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `snake_case`                         | Functions, methods,          | stdlib, NumPy, pandas,     |
|                                      | variables, modules           | pytest                     |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`               | Constants, env vars, config  | Django settings, Flask     |
|                                      | flags                        | config                     |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `kebab-case`                         | CLI commands, PyPI names,    | `scikit-learn`,            |
|                                      | URLs[^kebab]                 | `pip-tools`                |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `dot.case`                           | Namespaces, config keys,     | `getLogger(__name__)`      |
|                                      | loggers                      |                            |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `path/case`                          | File paths, package dirs,    | Django / Flask routes      |
|                                      | routes                       |                            |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `test_` prefix                       | Tests (pytest discovery)     | `test_*.py`, `*_test.py`,  |
|                                      |                              | `Test*`                    |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `_leading_underscore`                | Private by convention        | stdlib, most libraries     |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `__dunder__`                         | Special methods, protocol    | `__init__`, `__repr__`,    |
|                                      | hooks                        | `__iter__`                 |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| `__leading_double_underscore`        | Name-mangled class           | Used selectively in        |
|                                      | internals[^mangle]           | classes                    |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+
| Spaced Title Case                    | Human-facing titles, UI      | Sphinx / MkDocs headings   |
|                                      | labels                       |                            |
+--------------------------------------+------------------------------+----------------------------+

**Core rule (PEP 8):** CapWords for classes, `snake_case` for functions/variables, `UPPER_CASE` for constants.

[^camel]: Python wrappers may preserve upstream camelCase fields.
[^kebab]: Not a valid Python identifier; common for PyPI distribution names.
[^mangle]: Reduces subclass name collisions.
